title: YourMondayMotivator: Argh! So much to do
html: I have a lot to get done this morning by 8am so I can get on the road and sit in traffic for 40 minutes. The traffic part isn't cool but it will be worth it because today is the final day of a course I have doing that has been very valuable to me. It's called Business Domino's and is run at ATEED. Check it out. So why the 'argh'?. We have a builder here this morning so I am writing this in between getting ready to go, moving cars and making sure we are all on the same page. It's a little bit overwhelming but has to be done. And that is my little insight for today. Whatever you absolutelyhave to get done gets done no matter how little time you have or where you have to be. That is a very important lesson because in my opinion a lot of people get to a point where they feel they have put enough effort in to their life, day, relationship, work etc and then cruise. They let unimportant stuff fill their days and then wonder why they don't get what they want. There are things that if you make them so important they absolutely have to be done you will achieve more than you ever thought possible. It's a mindset. It will take a of effort to do because we are all basically lazy and want to be sitting at the beach. I'm not that great at doing this. I am constantly working on making things so important I have to do them. But I'm into the 80/20 rule and if I can be awesome at this 80% of the time then life will not pass me by. This week make things important, do them first, and have a great week.
